lines.en: scene fyeptwo49
: {i}It looks like Ami and Chika have both tried to get into contact with me and that...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看来 Ami 和 Chika 都试着联系过我，而那……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, both of them are scary. And I’m not sure either one is safe to be around right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，她们两个都挺吓人。而且我不确定现在待在她们任何一个身边是安全的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I should at least call them back, right? Anything to get me away from Otoha’s ultimate form.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但至少我该给她们回个电话吧？只要能让我远离 Otoha 的最终形态，什么都行。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What should I do?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我该怎么办？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chika’s still...the safest bet, isn’t she? Obviously Ami has more experience caring for me specifically, but if she were to see me like this, she might just tie me up and prevent me from ever leaving the house again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika 还是……最稳妥的选择，对吧？显然 Ami 更擅长专门照顾我，但如果她看到我这副样子，她大概会直接把我绑起来，让我再也出不了家门。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Plus, Chika has experience with Chinami. And since I’m probably close to her age now- no! What am I saying?! I’m an adult!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说，Chika 有照顾 Chinami 的经验。而且既然我现在大概跟她差不多大——不！我在说什么？！我是成年人！{/i}

lines.en: scene noonsky
: {i}I don’t need someone to watch after me! I need someone to help me! And for reasons I can’t really explain on a narrative level, that person appears to be Chika right now!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不需要有人照看我！我需要有人帮我！而由于一些我在叙事层面上没法真正解释的原因，那个人现在看来是 Chika！{/i}

lines.en: I tap on her name with my stupid tiny fingers and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我用我那愚蠢的小手指点了一下她的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: : {i}Sensei! Finally! I’ve been calling you like crazy! Is everything okay? I heard, uhh...something happened.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei！终于！我一直在疯狂给你打电话！一切都还好吗？我听说，呃……出了点事。{/i}

lines.en: : No! I’m not okay! Because if {i}you{/i} know, it means {i}everyone{/i} must know! My life is over!
lines.zh: : 不好！我一点都不好！因为如果{i}你{/i}都知道了，那就意味着{i}所有人{/i}肯定都知道了！我的人生完了！

lines.en: : {i}It’s true then?! You really...turned back into a kid?
lines.zh: : {i}那这是真的了？！你真的……变回小孩了？

lines.en: : Who told you? Was it Ayane? Maya? It wasn’t {i}Wakana,{/i} was it?
lines.zh: : 谁告诉你的？是 Ayane 吗？Maya？该不会是{i}Wakana{/i} 吧？

lines.en: : {i}Tsubasa.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Tsubasa.{/i}

lines.en: : Well, how the fuck does she know?!
lines.zh: : 那她他妈怎么知道的？！

lines.en: : {i}She’s Tsubasa. She knows everything. Also, no cursing! You’re not old enough yet!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她是 Tsubasa。她什么都知道。还有，不许说脏话！你还不够大！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Chika, you need to help me. There are very dangerous people in this city masquerading as normal alt girls and I need to get away from them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika，你得帮我。这座城市里有非常危险的人伪装成普通的另类女孩，我得离她们远点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don’t worry, I’m on it. Tsubasa and I are driving around right now and will come pick you up. Where are you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别担心，交给我。我和 Tsubasa 现在正在开车，会来接你。你在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...I can’t...provide the specific address. But I’ll send you one nearby and you guys can meet me there. Also, please don’t laugh at me.
lines.zh: : 呃……我没法……提供具体地址。但我会发你一个附近的，你们在那儿跟我会合。还有，请别笑我。

lines.en: : {i}Of course! But only if you promise to not laugh at me if I get really excited to see mini Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然！但前提是你保证，如果我看到迷你 Sensei 特别兴奋的时候你不笑我。{/i}

lines.en: : Don’t! Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 别！再见！

lines.en: I hang up the phone, taking a quick glance back to Otoha to confirm that she’s still unconscious from reveling in her dark affinities before putting my clothes back on and leaving.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，回头飞快瞥了一眼 Otoha，确认她还沉浸在那些黑暗癖好里没醒过来，然后穿上衣服离开。

lines.en: scene fyepthree1
Being out in broad daylight is a new type of threatening. So much so that I think I’d feel more comfortable being out here naked.
lines.zh: 在大白天出门是种全新的威胁感。严重到我觉得，就算光着身子待在外面大概都会更自在一些。

lines.en: As my normal self, obviously. The most important course of action right now is just figuring out how to get my body back.
lines.zh: 当然，是以我平常的样子。眼下最重要的行动就是搞清楚怎么把身体变回来。

lines.en: And I {i}assumed{/i} Nodoka would be able to assist me with that given that knowing stuff is just {i}what she does.{/i} But I guess my intellect vanished along with my penis size.
lines.zh: 而我{i}本以为{/i} Nodoka 能在这件事上帮我，毕竟「知道东西」就是{i}她的本事{/i}。但看来我的智力也跟着阴茎尺寸一起消失了。

lines.en: scene fyepthree2
Or maybe those two things are tied directly together in my case? That would make sense.
lines.zh: 又或者在我这种情况下，那两样东西是直接绑在一起的？那倒也说得通。

lines.en: Whatever the case, I can’t let anyone like Otoha get their hands on me again. And I don’t think Chika {i}would{/i} go down that same path, but that doesn’t mean there aren’t others who-
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我不能再让像 Otoha 那样的人碰到我。而且我觉得 Chika {i}应该不会{/i}走上同一条路，但那不意味着没有别人会——

lines.en: : Hey, you. Kid.
lines.zh: : 喂，你。小孩。

lines.en: scene fyepthree3
: Hm?
scene fyepthree4 with flash
{i}OH GOD, NO!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦天哪，不要！{/i}

lines.en: : Are you okay? You look lost.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？你看起来迷路了。

lines.en: : Are you waiting for your parents or something? Because the bus station’s way better for that. Cars aren’t really supposed to stop here.
lines.zh: : 你在等你父母还是什么？因为干那事去公交站好得多。这儿本来不该停车的。

lines.en: : Are you...a tourist, maybe? Can you understand Japanese?
lines.zh: : 你是……游客吗？你听得懂日语吗？

lines.en: : You...You don’t recognize me?
lines.zh: : 你……你不认识我？

lines.en: scene fyepthree5
: I...don’t think so? You do seem kind of familiar, though. Are you, like...related to anyone-
lines.zh: : 我……不认识吧？不过你确实有点眼熟。你是……谁的亲戚之类的——

lines.en: : No. I am a tourist. We have never met before. And I {i}do{/i} speak Japanese.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是游客。我们以前从没见过。而且我{i}确实{/i}会说日语。

lines.en: scene fyepthree6
: I can see that. Are you sure you want to be wandering around here all alone, though? I doubt you’re traveling solo at your age. So maybe I could help you find your parents?
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。不过你确定要一个人在这儿乱逛吗？我不觉得你这年纪会独自旅行。所以也许我可以帮你找父母？

lines.en: : My name’s Kirin. I’m not a bad person, I promise. What’s {i}your{/i} name?
lines.zh: : 我叫 Kirin。我保证我不是坏人。{i}你{/i}叫什么？

lines.en: : I’m......uhh......Nozomu.
lines.zh: : 我是……呃……Nozomu。

lines.en: scene fyepthree7
: That’s...masculine.
lines.zh: : 这名字……挺男性化的。

lines.en: : Th...Thanks...
scene fyepthree8
: Are you thirsty, Nozomu-kun? Anything in particular you’re out here searching for?
lines.zh: : 你渴吗，Nozomu 君？你在这儿是想找什么特别的东西吗？

lines.en: : You’re not...trying to kidnap me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是……想绑架我吧？

lines.en: scene fyepthree9
: What? No! Of course not! I just felt weird about walking by you without seeing if you needed help. I’ve been lost when I was your age before. It’s super scary. But if you’re sure you’re okay-
lines.zh: : 什么？不！当然不是！我只是觉得，看到你却不过来看看你需不需要帮忙就走过去，感觉怪怪的。我像你这么大的时候也迷路过。特别吓人。但如果你确定你没事——

lines.en: : I...can’t believe you’re actually a good person.
lines.zh: : 我……真不敢相信你居然是个好人。

lines.en: scene black
: You shouldn’t say things like that about your elders, Nozomu-kun. Are you not from around here? Osaka, maybe? I hear the people over there are always being all blunt like that.
lines.zh: : 你不该对长辈说这种话，Nozomu 君。你不是本地人吧？大阪？我听说那边的人老是这么直。

lines.en: scene fyepthree10
: Uhh...sure. That is where I am from.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。我就是从那儿来的。

lines.en: : You like it there?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢那儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。

lines.en: : What brings you to Kumon-mi then? When’d you get here?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么会来 Kumon-mi？你什么时候到的？

lines.en: : T...Today.
lines.zh: : 就……今天。

lines.en: scene fyepthree11
: Today?! How’d you get in through the barrier?! Oh my god — did I bump into some politician’s kid or something? Are you actually super rich? Are you-
lines.zh: : 今天？！你怎么穿过屏障进来的？！天哪——我该不会是撞上哪个政客的孩子了吧？你其实超有钱？你是——

lines.en: : No! I...uhh...made a mistake! I...woke up from a coma today! But I was born in Osaka and now I am just...wandering around this place I do not know. I also have no parents.
lines.zh: : 不是！我……呃……说错了！我……今天刚从昏迷中醒来！但我出生在大阪，现在只是在……这个我不认识的地方到处乱走。我也没有父母。

lines.en: scene fyepthree12
: Nozomu-kun...I know what it looks like. A flashy girl like me coming up to you on the street...barraging you with a bunch of personal questions? Like, that’s obviously gonna raise some flags.
lines.zh: : Nozomu 君……我知道这看起来像什么。像我这样招摇的女孩在街上走向你……连珠炮似的问你一堆私人问题？这显然会让人起疑。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}soliciting{/i} you or anything, though. So if you don’t want to talk, just tell me. You don’t need to blurt out a bunch of lies like that. I’ll gladly leave on my own if I’m making you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 不过我不是在{i}拉客{/i}什么的。所以如果你不想聊，直接告诉我。你不用那样脱口而出一堆谎话。如果我让你不自在，我很乐意自己走开。

lines.en: : It’s...not that you’re making me {i}uncomfortable.{/i} I just...it’s better if you don’t realize what’s...{i}actually{/i} going on here.
lines.zh: : 不是……你让我{i}不自在{/i}。我只是……你最好别意识到这里……{i}实际{/i}上在发生什么。

lines.en: : What’s {i}actually{/i} going on here? Nozomu-kun, all we have over here are adult shops and love hotels and-
lines.zh: : 这里{i}实际{/i}上在发生什么？Nozomu 君，我们这儿只有成人用品店和爱情旅馆还有——

lines.en: scene fyepthree13
: Oh my god! You’re not...here to meet some sort of...prostitute or-
lines.zh: : 天哪！你不是……来见某种……妓女还是——

lines.en: : No! I’m just waiting for my friend to pick me up!
lines.zh: : 不是！我只是在等我朋友来接我！

lines.en: : Nozomu-kun. Please be honest. Have you {i}met{/i} this friend in person before? Because people online can be very scary. And if they want to meet you {i}here-{/i}
lines.zh: : Nozomu 君。请说实话。你以前{i}见过{/i}这个朋友本人吗？因为网上的人可以非常可怕。而如果他们想{i}在这儿{/i}见你——

lines.en: scene fyepthree14 with hpunch
: Akira Arakawa — please enter the vehicle immediately.
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa——请立刻上车。

lines.en: scene fyepthree15
: Hey, asshole! Just for your information, you’re not allowed to stop your car there! This area is off limits to-
lines.zh: : 喂，混蛋！跟你说一声，你不准把车停在那儿！这一带禁止——

lines.en: scene fyepthree16
: Did you just say “Akira Arakawa?”
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是说了「Akira Arakawa」？

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene fyepthree17
: Later, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Kirin。

lines.en: scene fyepthree18
: Right this way, master Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 这边请，Arakawa 少爷。

lines.en: : {i}KYAAAAAAAH! I CAN’T BELIEVE MY EYES! IT’S ACTUALLY TRUE!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呀啊啊啊啊啊！我不敢相信我的眼睛！居然是真的！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}DON’T LOOK AT ME!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别看我！{/i}

lines.en: scene fyepthree19
: Um.
scene fyepthree20 with flash
: OH. MY. GOD! YOU ARE SO FRIGGIN’ ADORABLE THAT I’M NOT EVEN GOING TO BOTHER ASKING WHY YOU WERE JUST WITH KIRIN!
lines.zh: : 天。哪。啊！你可爱到我都懒得问你刚才为什么跟 Kirin 在一起了！

lines.en: : I agree with Chika that you do look quite precious as a child, Akira. Tsukasa would be over the moon right now.
lines.zh: : 我同意 Chika 的看法，你变成小孩的样子确实挺宝贝的，Akira。Tsukasa 现在肯定会乐疯了。

lines.en: : How did you know?! Why do you seem so calm?! When will I be big again?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？！你为什么这么淡定？！我什么时候才能变回大人？！

lines.en: : KYAAAAH! AND NOW HE’S THROWING A TEMPER TANTRUM! I LOVE IT! COME HOME WITH ME!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊啊！现在他还在闹脾气！我爱死了！跟我回家吧！

lines.en: scene fyepthree21
: Chika, darling — calm yourself. I’ve already informed you it’s just temporary, yes.
lines.zh: : Chika，亲爱的——冷静点。我已经告诉过你了，这只是暂时的，对吧。

lines.en: : {i}Yeaaaaaah...{/i}but that doesn’t mean I can’t enjoy it while it’s happening, right?
lines.zh: : {i}是～啦……{/i}但那不代表我不能在它发生的时候好好享受，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s...it’s really temporary? How do you know that? And again, how did you know in the first place?
lines.zh: : 这……这真的是暂时的？你怎么知道？还有，你一开始到底怎么知道的？

lines.en: scene fyepthree22
: I’d be happy to tell you, little Aki-kun. But unfortunately, if I did, I’d need to keep you this way forever. Which {i}some{/i} people would be rather happy about, mind you.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意告诉你，小 Aki 君。但不幸的是，如果我说了，我就得让你永远保持这个样子。顺便说一句，{i}有些{/i}人会挺乐意的。

lines.en: : It isn’t often that adults can simple {i}shave decades off of their lives,{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 成年人能随随便便{i}把人生削掉几十年{/i}这种事可不常见，你知道的。

lines.en: scene fyepthree23
: Tsubasa says she knows somebody who can “reconfigure” you or something like that. I don’t get it. It sounded really complicated.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 说她认识能把你「重新配置」还是什么的人。我没听懂。听起来特别复杂。

lines.en: : A simpler way to put it would be to say that Akira has somehow wound up manipulating the fabric of reality and annoyed a vengeful god who decided to smite him because they thought it would be funny.
lines.zh: : 简单点说就是：Akira 不知怎么弄到了能操纵现实构造的地步，惹恼了一个记仇的神，于是那神决定劈他一下，因为觉得那样会很好玩。

lines.en: : Yeah! Totally simple!
lines.zh: : 对啊！超级简单！

lines.en: : This is why I hate religion! Those things are always fucking with me!
lines.zh: : 这就是我讨厌宗教的原因！那些东西老是跟我过不去！

lines.en: : I don’t care what you have to do! Just change me back already!
lines.zh: : 我不管你非得做什么！赶紧把我变回去！

lines.en: scene fyepthree24
: It’s not something I do {i}myself,{/i} Akira. There are certain preparations that need to be made and things that need to be done. I imagine it will take a full week at minimum.
lines.zh: : 这不是{i}我自己{/i}能做的事，Akira。有些准备得做，有些事得办。我想最少也得花整整一周。

lines.en: : Tsubasa — I don’t think you understand how much danger I am in right now.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa——我觉得你没明白我现在有多危险。

lines.en: : Of course I do, Akira. It’s the same danger my Tsukasa is in whenever you visit her. And if {i}she{/i} is fine, I’m sure you will be too.
lines.zh: : 我当然明白，Akira。那跟我家 Tsukasa 每次被你拜访时面临的危险是一样的。如果{i}她{/i}都没事，我相信你也会没事。

lines.en: : She’s obviously kidding, Sensei. Tsubasa knows you’d never do anything to hurt Tsukasa. But don’t worry — I’ve got this under control. You’ll be staying at my place until it’s time to change you back.
lines.zh: : 她显然是在开玩笑，Sensei。Tsubasa 知道你不会做任何伤害 Tsukasa 的事。不过别担心——这事我来处理。在变回去之前你就住我那儿。

lines.en: : That is...{i}if{/i} you still want to change back after one week, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那得是……{i}如果{/i}一周之后你还想变回去，Akira。

lines.en: scene fyepthree25
: Well...why would he not {i}want{/i} to?
lines.zh: : 嗯……他为什么会{i}不想{/i}变回去？

lines.en: : Because this is a rare opportunity. And one that I imagine {i}you{/i} would be quite happy to see him take in about several years’ time. Unless you are...{i}specifically{/i} attracted to older men.
lines.zh: : 因为这是个罕见的机会。而且我猜，再过几年，{i}你{/i}会很乐意看到他抓住这个机会。除非你……{i}偏偏{/i}对年长的男人有兴趣。

lines.en: : You mean like...shrinking our age gap?
lines.zh: : 你是说……比如缩小我们的年龄差？

lines.en: : That’s right. Because Akira may seem a tad bit {i}young{/i} now. But by the time he’s finished with school-
lines.zh: : 没错。因为 Akira 现在可能显得有点{i}小{/i}。但等他念完书——

lines.en: : There’s no way I’m going back to school as a student! I don’t even like going there as a teacher!
lines.zh: : 我绝不可能以学生的身份回学校！我连当老师去那儿都不喜欢！

lines.en: scene fyepthree26
: We can talk about it later, okay? For now, we’ve gotta get you settled into my apartment. There is {i}no{/i} way I am letting Ami take you like this. You will probably die.
lines.zh: : 这事以后再说，好吗？现在得先把你安置到我的公寓。我{i}绝不{/i}会让 Ami 这样把你带走。你大概会死。

lines.en: : I...will not disagree with that. But I think it would {i}still{/i} be good if we at least {i}told{/i} her about-
lines.zh: : 我……不会反对这一点。但我觉得，至少我们{i}告诉{/i}她一声{i}还是{/i}比较好，关于——

lines.en: : The fewer people who know, the better. I sincerely apologize, but that’s simply how it must be if you are to increase your chances of changing back.
lines.zh: : 知道的人越少越好。我真心道歉，但如果你想提高变回去的几率，就只能这样。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} urge you to think about it though, Akira. This could very much be a blessing in disguise.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}确实{/i}劝你考虑一下，Akira。这很可能是一件因祸得福的好事。

lines.en: : And should you be worried about certain...{i}intimate aspects{/i} of your life and how this may impact them, don’t be. Arrangements can be made to take care of that too.
lines.zh: : 而如果你担心你生活中某些……{i}亲密方面{/i}以及这事会对它们造成什么影响，不必担心。那方面也能安排。

lines.en: : Hi. Arrangement here. Not exactly proud of it — but if it’s what must be done, I’m willing to do it.
lines.zh: : 嗨。安排在这儿。我不是特别为此骄傲——但如果这是必须做的事，我愿意做。

lines.en: : See how loved you are, Akira? {i}Despite{/i} the shape you’ve found yourself in?
lines.zh: : 看到你有多被爱了吗，Akira？{i}哪怕{/i}你现在变成了这副样子？

lines.en: : All I see is that I’m beginning to regret not staying with Ayane when I had the chance.
lines.zh: : 我只看到，我开始后悔有机会的时候没留在 Ayane 那儿。

lines.en: scene black
: Ayane’s a sweetheart, sure! {i}But she can’t love you the way I do...{/i}
lines.zh: : Ayane 是个甜心，当然！{i}但她没法像我这样爱你……{/i}

lines.en: : Chika — it’s fine if we drop you off at your residence now, yes? I need to speak with Tomonori about this.
lines.zh: : Chika——我们现在把你送到你住处就行了吧？我得跟 Tomonori 谈谈这件事。

lines.en: : Yup! Sensei, you don’t need to grab any clothes from your house, do- oh. They wouldn’t fit you. BUUUUUUT maybe we should get them anyway to see how cute you’d look in oversized-
lines.zh: : 对！Sensei，你不用回家拿衣服了，对——哦。它们不合你的身。不～过～也许我们还是该去拿，看看你穿超大号衣服有多可爱——

lines.en: : Driver — can you drop me off at the Amamiya mansion?
lines.zh: : 司机——能把我送到 Amamiya 宅邸吗？

lines.en: : Aaah! Sensei, no! Don’t leave me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！Sensei，不要！别丢下我！

lines.en: scene noonsky
We eventually make it to Chika’s place. But before I’m able to exit the car, Tsubasa holds me down and steals my phone out of my pocket...so I can’t call Ami even if I {i}want{/i} to now.
lines.zh: 我们最后到了 Chika 家。但在我下车之前，Tsubasa 把我按住，从我口袋里偷走了手机……所以现在就算我{i}想{/i}打给 Ami 也打不了了。

lines.en: Which...I’m still not sure if I do.
lines.zh: 而……我还不确定我到底想不想。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of time until she hears what happened from Ayane or Maya...or even Kirin now assuming she hasn’t {i}already{/i} heard.
lines.zh: 她从 Ayane 或 Maya 那儿听说发生了什么只是时间问题……甚至是 Kirin——假设她{i}还{/i}没听说的话。

lines.en: And yeah...I guess it is safer for me at Chika’s.
lines.zh: 而且是啊……我猜待在 Chika 那儿对我来说确实更安全。

lines.en: It just doesn’t feel normal. And normalcy is what I crave right now more than anything.
lines.zh: 只是感觉不正常。而正常，正是我现在最渴望的东西。

lines.en: scene fyepthree27 with flash
Maybe right after water, though. I’m still very tired from-
lines.zh: 不过也许先喝水吧。我还是很累，因为——

lines.en: : Why do you smell like Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你为什么有 Otoha 的味道？

lines.en: scene fyepthree28
: I have no idea...
: Hooray! Big sis Chika’s home!
lines.zh: : 万岁！Chika 姐姐回来了！

lines.en: scene fyepthree29
: Welcome back! Chinami missed-
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来！Chinami 好想——

lines.en: : Hi, Chinami! Look! I brought a surprise!
lines.zh: : 嗨，Chinami！你看！我带了个惊喜回来！

scene fyepthree34
: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: scene fyepthree35 with hpunch
: {i}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!{/i}

lines.en: : Kill me.
lines.zh: : 杀了我吧。

lines.en: : Kyaaaah! My little sister’s first crush! And it’s on my boyfriend! I’ve been waiting my whole life for this!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊啊！我妹妹的初恋！而且对象是我男朋友！我这辈子都在等这一天！

lines.en: : Her reaction to her first crush is locking herself in the bathroom and screaming?
lines.zh: : 她对初恋的反应就是把自己锁在浴室里尖叫？

lines.en: : Of course! Is that not normal?
lines.zh: : 当然！这不正常吗？

lines.en: : I have no clue...
lines.zh: : 我一点头绪都没有......

lines.en: scene fyepthree36
: Mmm! I’m so happy I could die!
lines.zh: : 嗯！我高兴得要死了！

lines.en: : Take me with you.
lines.zh: : 带我一起。

lines.en: scene fyepthree37
: Sorry, I should have warned you that might happen. It’s her first time seeing a boy her own age. And she’d {i}obviously{/i} have impeccable taste since she is {i}my{/i} sister.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我早该提醒你可能会这样。这是她第一次见到同龄的男孩。而且既然她是我{i}妹妹{/i}，她的品味{i}显然{/i}无可挑剔。

lines.en: : So yeah. We might need to buy you earplugs if you’re going to be sleeping here.
lines.zh: : 所以是啊。如果你要睡这儿，我们可能得给你买副耳塞。

lines.en: : Can I have a glass of water please?
lines.zh: : 能给我一杯水吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Sure! Come sit. We can talk while we wait for Chinami to recover from the biggest shock of her life.
lines.zh: : 当然！过来坐。我们可以边等 Chinami 从她人生最大的冲击里缓过来边聊。

lines.en: scene fyepthree38 with flash
: {i}{size=-10}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!{/size}{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-10}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!{/size}{/i}

lines.en: : Cheer up, okay? I know it probably sucks being so small again, but you’ll be back to normal in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 打起精神，好吗？我知道又变这么小大概很糟，但你很快就能恢复正常。

lines.en: : Is that how you want me, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你想让我那样吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean? Of {i}course{/i} that’s how I want you. I fell in love with my teacher, not some little kid.
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？我{i}当然{/i}想让你那样。我爱上的是我的老师，不是什么小屁孩。

lines.en: : That’s...both surprising and comforting to hear. Thank you, Chika.
lines.zh: : 这话……既让我意外又让我安心。谢谢你，Chika。

lines.en: : There’s no need to thank me. It’s my job as your girlfriend to make sure you’re feeling comfortable during times like this.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我。作为你女朋友，确保你在这种时候感到舒服就是我的职责。

lines.en: : I don’t think there is anything in the girlfriend manual about what to do when your boyfriend gets turned back into a child.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得《女朋友手册》里有写到男朋友变回小孩时该怎么办。

lines.en: : But if there {i}was,{/i} I don’t think it’d say “take advantage of him.” Like, I’m sure if the tables were turned, you’d be good to me too, right?
lines.zh: : 但如果{i}真有{/i}的话，我觉得它也不会写「趁机占他便宜」。就是说，我确定如果换作是你，你也会对我好的，对吧？

lines.en: : Let’s...just hope the tables {i}don’t{/i} turn.
lines.zh: : 我们……就祈祷别{i}换过来{/i}吧。

lines.en: : Heheh...
: So...how’s it feel? Any different? {i}Hormones{/i} kick in yet?
lines.zh: : 那……感觉怎么样？有什么不一样吗？{i}荷尔蒙{/i}开始上来了吗？

lines.en: : Are you {i}enticed{/i} by the beautiful onee-san who just got you a glass of water?
lines.zh: : 你有没有被那个刚给你端来一杯水的漂亮姐姐{i}勾引{/i}到？

lines.en: : Depends. Are {i}you{/i} enticed by a weird looking brat caught in a perpetual tantrum?
lines.zh: : 看情况。{i}你{/i}有没有被一个长相古怪、永远在闹脾气的小鬼勾引到？

lines.en: : The real you’s still in there, obviously. No kid could pull off passive aggressiveness and sarcasm that well.
lines.zh: : 真正的你显然还在里面。没有哪个小孩能把被动攻击和挖苦玩得这么溜。

lines.en: : You clearly haven’t spoken much to Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 你显然没跟 Tsukasa 说过多少话。

lines.en: : Tsukasa’s just a snobby rich girl. They come out like that. She’ll turn into another Touka one day, I’m sure. Motherly. Like me — just with money.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 只是个势利的有钱女孩。那种人天生就这样。我确定她总有一天会变成另一个 Touka。有母性。像我一样——只是多了钱。

lines.en: : You {i}will{/i} make a good mom one day.
lines.zh: : 你总有一天{i}会{/i}成为好妈妈的。

lines.en: : I have a response to that. I just don’t think I can say it to you in your current {i}state.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我对这话有回应。只是我觉得，在你现在的{i}状态{/i}下我没法跟你说。

lines.en: : Would you really, like...you know...
lines.zh: : 你真的会，那个……你知道的……

lines.en: scene fyepthree39
: Good question.
lines.zh: : 好问题。

lines.en: : If it wasn’t you, obviously not. I mostly just said what I had to to stop Tsubasa from trying to {i}suggest{/i} stuff. Lord knows what goes on in Tsukioka Manor.
lines.zh: : 如果不是你，那当然不会。我那么说主要只是为了阻止 Tsubasa 继续{i}暗示{/i}那些事。天知道 Tsukioka 宅邸里在搞什么。

lines.en: scene fyepthree40
: Would you, though? In that state? You’re not embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 不过你会吗？在那个状态下？你不觉得尴尬？

lines.en: : Of course I’m embarrassed. This sucks.
lines.zh: : 我当然觉得尴尬。这太糟了。

lines.en: : Is it because you can’t seem as {i}powerful{/i} as you normally do? Does the size thing really make that much of a difference in your head?
lines.zh: : 是因为你没法像平时那样显得{i}强大{/i}吗？尺寸这件事在你脑子里真的差别那么大？

lines.en: : Well, it clearly does in yours if you’re acknowledging how weird you feel about our current predicament.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然你都承认你对我们现在的处境感觉有多怪，那在你脑子里显然差别很大。

lines.en: : I don’t really know {i}how{/i} I feel. This isn’t exactly an issue I ever prepared myself to deal with.
lines.zh: : 我其实不知道我{i}是什么{/i}感觉。这可不是我曾经准备好要应付的问题。

lines.en: : I just know that I love you regardless of shape or size. And that dating me comes with all of same benefits it would if you were your normal self.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，不管形状还是尺寸，我都爱你。而且跟我交往能得到的全部好处，跟你平时的时候一样多。

lines.en: : {i}{size=-10}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!{/size}{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-10}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!{/size}{/i}

lines.en: scene fyepthree41
: Or maybe I’m just saying that because I don’t want Chinami to try and steal you from me.
lines.zh: : 又或者我这么说只是因为我不想让 Chinami 试图把你从我这儿抢走。

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami is okay now! H-Hello...b...boy!
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 现在没事了！你……你好……男……男孩！

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! Come here.
lines.zh: : Chinami！过来。

lines.en: : Let me fill you in on what happened...
lines.zh: : 我来跟你说说发生了什么……

lines.en: scene fyepthree42
: So...{i}you’re{/i} Papa?...
lines.zh: : 所以……{i}你{/i}就是爸爸？……

lines.en: : But only for a little bit while Tsubasa figures out how to turn him back.
lines.zh: : 但只是暂时的，等 Tsubasa 想出怎么把他变回去。

lines.en: scene fyepthree43
: Are you nervous, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗，Chinami？

lines.en: : He’s cute, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 他很可爱，对吧？

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami...shouldn’t...say things like that about her Papa...
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami……不该……说爸爸这种话……

lines.en: : Not even if he’s the same size as you right now?
lines.zh: : 就算他现在跟你一样大也不行？

lines.en: : Chika, are you {i}trying{/i} to egg her on?
lines.zh: : Chika，你是{i}故意{/i}在撺掇她吗？

lines.en: scene fyepthree44
: Yes!
: Oh. I kind of assumed you were going to deny it.
lines.zh: : 哦。我还以为你会否认。

lines.en: : I’ve never gotten to see this side of her before. I think it’s cute.
lines.zh: : 我以前从来没见过她这一面。我觉得挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Chinami...does not enjoy...the drastic turn her life is taking right now...
lines.zh: : Chinami……不喜欢……她的人生现在这种剧变……

lines.en: : Well, for what it’s worth, neither do I.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎么说，我也不喜欢。

lines.en: : I suppose that means you’ll be sticking with {i}me{/i} then? To avoid any more {i}drastic{/i} changes?
lines.zh: : 那我猜这意味着你会一直跟着{i}我{/i}了？免得再有更{i}剧烈{/i}的变化？

lines.en: : Are you...going somewhere?
lines.zh: : 你……要出门？

lines.en: scene fyepthree45
: Just to pick up some groceries since there are {i}four{/i} mouths to feed here now.
lines.zh: : 只是去买点杂货，因为现在这里有{i}四{/i}张嘴要喂。

lines.en: : Please do not let Yumi inside this house while I am this size.
lines.zh: : 我这副尺寸的时候，请别让 Yumi 进这栋房子。

lines.en: : Fair. Back down to three then. Either way, I still need groceries. And some clothes that’ll fit you.
lines.zh: : 合理。那就降回三张。不管怎样，我还是得买杂货。还有一些合你身的衣服。

lines.en: scene fyepthree46
: But {i}maybe...{/i}we could stop somewhere else for a little while. {i}If{/i} you want to. Since sleeping in the same room might lead to some...{i}complications{/i} with Chinami here.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}也许……{/i}我们可以先去别的地方待一会儿。{i}如果{/i}你想的话。因为跟 Chinami 睡同一个房间可能会带来一些……{i}麻烦{/i}。

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami thinks big sis Chika...shouldn’t talk that way...to kids...
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 觉得 Chika 姐姐……不该那样……跟小孩说话……

lines.en: scene fyepthree47
: What do {i}you{/i} think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Wanna go on a little night time date with Onee-san? Or do you {i}not{/i} need to get anything out of your system after all?
lines.zh: : 想跟姐姐去来一场小小的夜间约会吗？还是说你{i}并不{/i}需要把体内的东西排出来？

lines.en: : Chinami thinks......Papa should go with big sis Chika.......since she doesn’t want her.......to get lonely.....
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得……爸爸应该跟 Chika 姐姐去……因为她不想让她……感到孤单……

lines.en: {i}The time has come to make a choice...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}做出选择的时刻到了……{/i}
